name: Inuyama
tagline: An original castle above the Kiso River.
intro_en: Inuyama sits on the Kiso River on Aichi's northern edge, and its hilltop castle is one of only five in Japan whose main keep is a designated National Treasure. Below it, the old castle-town streets are lined with wooden merchant houses, small sake breweries and snack stalls that make for an easy half-day stroll.
In the warmer months the river becomes the stage for ukai, the centuries-old practice of cormorant fishing by firelight, watched from traditional boats.
getting_there_en: Inuyama is on the Meitetsu Inuyama Line from Meitetsu Nagoya Station; the castle and old town are a short walk from Inuyama Station or Inuyama-yuen Station.
